statement: Let a=r^(-eta)<=1/4, eta>0. The wrapped centered Gaussian of variance 2eta log r has density p=(1+2sum_{n>=1}a^(n^2)cos(nphi))/(2pi) and first vertex coefficient a. The positive density q=p-a cos(phi)/pi has zero first vertex coefficient and d_TV(P,Q)=2a/pi, using d_TV=sup_A|P(A)-Q(A)|. Thus even O(r^(-eta)) approximation error can erase the full algebraic correlation; o(r^(-eta)) controls it by |E_P f-E_Q f|<=2d_TV for |f|<=1.
assumptions: No assertion that the pair laws form a stationary microscopic field
proof_or_counterexample: Remove the first Fourier mode; positivity follows from 2sum_{n>=2}a^(n^2)<=2a^4/(1-a^2)<1. Integrate |a cos(phi)/pi|/2 to obtain 2a/pi. Full proof: ATTEMPT.md C2.

remaining_gap: Provides a necessary error scale for the route, not a microscopic hexatic state.
